maya: Quick idea — tiny OSS 'mini-kit' we add to GH READMEs + 3-email drip. Goal: faster time-to-first-success, route inbound to webinar/trials.
dave: Love it. Keep 3 things: <5min quickstart, reproducible benchmark (latency/cost), CTA to webinar + office hours.
arjun: Will add local Docker run + colab GPU example. Suggest `docker run ghcr.io/redwood/minikit:latest`.
sophie: I'll draft email drip: day0 quickstart, day2 benchmark tips, day6 webinar invite. A/B subject lines + UTM params.
liam: Mocked badge + readme link and tracking. Also prompt set for chat/summarize/extract.
dave: Routing rules: if checkbox 'sales' OR corporate domain -> SFDC lead tagged 'oss-minikit'; else -> nurture list 'oss-minikit'. Tag source=readme/email.
arjun: I'll produce benchmark snippet for CPU and small GPU with tokens/sec and $/1k tokens. Sample curl + timing.
maya: Timeline: copy + landing page Tue EOD, bench Wed, emails Thu, webinar next Wed. I'll create MARK-4321.
marketing-bot: Created JIRA MARK-4321 assigned to maya.
sophie: Posting draft later today.
arjun: I'll add GH Action `ci/build-minikit.yml` to publish on tag.
maya: Great, thanks — once copy is in I'll wire routing with eng-ops. :rocket:
